review.notes: Full re-review. All 8 findings of the previous review are repaired. Gate: the worker's gate passes; my rerun shows only the known false positives (default order; the family index), and the order-aware depcheck reports 0 problems. Suggested.lean elaborates with 7 sorry warnings only; the one-tactic probe closes nothing; no name collides.
